# BarcodeSymbology

`Flare.Components.BarcodeSymbology`

The 1D symbologies FlareBarcode can encode, ordered by how often they are actually asked for rather than alphabetically.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Code128` | `0` | Code 128 - the general-purpose symbology. Encodes the full ASCII range and switches between its A/B/C subsets automatically, so a run of digits costs half the width it would elsewhere. |
| `Ean13` | `1` | EAN-13 retail article number: 12 digits plus a check digit this computes. |
| `Ean8` | `2` | EAN-8, the short form for a small package: 7 digits plus a check digit. |
| `UpcA` | `3` | UPC-A, the North American retail code: 11 digits plus a check digit. |
| `Code39` | `4` | Code 39 - digits, upper-case letters and a handful of symbols. Widely readable by old hardware, and about three times wider than Code 128 for the same text. |
| `Itf14` | `5` | ITF-14 shipping-container code: 13 digits plus a check digit, interleaved two-of-five. |
| `Codabar` | `6` | Codabar - digits and six symbols, with a letter A-D at each end. Libraries and blood banks. |

## Used by components

- `FlareBarcode`
